reason: Independently reproduced on a woven Go 1.26.6 build with my own reproducer: after a real raw-socket disconnect (HTTP/1) or client cancel (HTTP/2) is observed server-side (handler saw req.Context().Done()), the request scope is still Active and a subsequent probe request gets DecisionCapacityDropped; with the default limit of 2, two stalled disconnected handlers disable IAST for all later requests until they return. The only release path is the deferred iasthttpbridge.Finish in serverHandler.ServeHTTP (iast/net/http/orchestrion.yml:27-33); nothing registers a context-cancellation release. Matches the brief's High definition (permanent IAST self-disable via a leaked admission slot); not a documented limitation.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go tool orchestrion go test ./iast/net/http -run TestFxDisconnectSlotRetention -count=1 -v -timeout 4m
